how_to_apply: Download and print the official application form format given in Annexure-II of the notification.
Fill in the required personal, contact, educational qualification, and experience details in block letters.
Paste a recent passport-size photograph on the form and sign across it where indicated.

Attach self-attested copies of certificates from matriculation onwards, mark sheets, degree/diploma certificates, experience certificates, and Aadhaar card. Candidates should ensure the application includes details of referees as required in the screening criteria.
If applying for more than one position, submit a separate application form for each post.
Send the completed application form along with all enclosures via email in PDF format to [email protected] on or before 1 November 2026.

Alternatively, submit the application by hand or via registered post/speed post/courier on or before 1 November 2026 to: Office of DFO Narendra Nagar, Van Parisar, Near GMVN Rest House, Muni Ki reti, Rishikesh, Tehri Garhwal, Uttarakhand – 249137.
For any correspondence, candidates can contact via phone at +91-8630904729 or email at [email protected].
important_instructions: Candidates must bring original documents of essential and desirable qualifications, 4 copies of recent passport-size photographs, Aadhaar card, and original experience certificates at the time of the interview. Candidates already employed in any Government organization must bring a "No Objection Certificate" (NOC) from their employer. Selected candidates must submit a medical certificate of fitness from a Competent Medical Officer at the time of joining. Candidates will not be allowed to accept or hold any other assignment during the period of engagement with the forest department. While leaving the job, appointees must hand over charge and obtain an NOC from the competent authority. Claims must be settled within three months of leaving the assignment; no claim will be entertained after three months. Candidates will be required to submit an undertaking stating that they will not approach a Court of Law in case services are terminated and will not claim regularization or service benefits in the Uttarakhand Forest Department. The engagement may be terminated with one month's notice by the competent authority C.F. Bhagirathi Circle in case of negligence, unbecoming conduct, non-availability of funds, or unforeseen circumstances. The Conservator of Forests, Bhagirathi Circle also reserves the right to cancel the entire process of engagement at any time without assigning any reason. Selected candidates wanting to leave the assignment must provide one month's prior notice; leaving without permission leads to non-payment of dues for that month. Headquarters is Muni Ki Reti, Tehri Garhwal, but candidates may be deputed to work in any division under Bhagirathi Circle.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely temporary and contractual. The initial tenure will be for 11 months from the date of joining, which can be extended or renewed depending on candidate performance and approval as per rules. The engagement carries no claim on permanency or regular employment under the Government of Uttarakhand. Senior Research Fellow (SRF): Rs. 42,000 per month + HRA Junior Research Fellow (JRF): Rs. 37,000 per month + HRA Junior Project Fellow (JPF): Rs. 24,000 per month + HRA Computer Operator: Rs. 18,000 per month (consolidated) House Rent Allowance (HRA) will be applicable to Pay Matrix-1 as per the HRA rules of the State Government. Only Casual Leave will be applicable as per State Government rules. Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) will be deducted as per prevailing Income Tax rules.

content_sections.heading: Uttarakhand Forest Department Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Personnel may be deputed to various forest divisions of Bhagirathi Circle (Narendra Nagar Forest Division, Tehri Forest Division, Uttarkashi Forest Division, Tehri Dam-I Forest Division, Tehri Dam-II Forest Division, and Soil Conservation Forest Division) to provide technical assistance to respective DFOs, SDOs, and field staff. Key duties include: Field visits of proposed ANR, CAT Plans, Eco Restoration Works, and GIM Research Work plots from time to time. Preparation of site-specific plans for all sites as prescribed in the annual plan for the next Silvicultural year. Preparation of maps and other required data for site-specific plans. Conducting surveys such as Rapid Mapping Exercise, rootstock calculation, and carbon stock calculation for prescribed plots. Providing technical and scientific assistance in tree marking according to working plan rules and guidelines. Establishing sample plots, demarcating boundaries, and recording baseline data on soil, species diversity, regeneration status, and environmental factors. Identifying and marking seed bearer trees with paint. Identifying and demarcating photo and video points for long-term monitoring. Maintaining research journals with survey and monitoring data, budgetary provisions, works, and photographs. Monitoring ongoing intervention works and submitting reports to the Conservator of Forests (CF), Bhagirathi Circle. Identifying plots suitable for monitoring by time-lapse cameras for phenological studies. Sampling and assessing natural regeneration in old plots using secondary data. Conducting training and workshops for frontline staff to upgrade technical skills. Performing critical analyses of intervention plots vis-à-vis field results and suggesting gap-filling measures. Identifying long-term monitoring indicators and preparing annual monitoring reports. Any other forestry or wildlife activities assigned by higher officials. Data Entry & Processing: Enter, digitize, and update official records, beneficiary lists, and government files into state databases and portals. Office Applications & Documentation: Draft letters, official memos, tables, and reports using MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and basic database software. G2C (Government-to-Citizen) Assistance: Help citizens and visitors register for online government schemes, complete digital applications, and process utility/administrative requests. System & Equipment Maintenance: Operate and maintain office computers, printers, scanners, and peripherals; troubleshoot minor software or hardware glitches and coordinate with IT support for major issues. Record Keeping & Filing: Maintain physical and digital logbooks of daily data entry work, correspondence, and system downtime.

Alternatively, submit the application by hand or via registered post/speed post/courier on or before 1 November 2026 to: Office of DFO Narendra Nagar, Van Parisar, Near GMVN Rest House, Muni Ki reti, Rishikesh, Tehri Garhwal, Uttarakhand – 249137. For any correspondence, candidates can contact via phone at +91-8630904729 or email at [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of document scrutiny followed by a personal interview: Screening: Applications will be scrutinized by a Screening Committee based on essential qualifications, age, completeness of documents, relevant field experience, and academic record. Candidates with more relevant experience and expertise will receive priority. The candidate's experience certificates should clearly specify whether they possess the experience, knowledge, skills, technology, or software platform requested in the essential or desirable experience requirements. Shortlisting: If a large number of applications are received, candidates will be shortlisted to a reasonable limit based on academic performance, qualifications, and experience benchmarks. Personal Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be contacted individually via their registered email ID and mobile number to appear for the personal interview conducted by the Selection Committee. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in Uttarakhand Forest Department Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 post for Senior Research Fellow (SRF)/Junior Research Fellow (JRF)/Junior Project Fellow (JPF) and 1 post for Computer Operator.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for Uttarakhand Forest Department Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of applications by email or post is 1 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Computer Operator post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Intermediate (10+2), hold at least a 6-month certificate/diploma in computer operations or applications, and have Hindi and English typing proficiency of 4,000 KDPH (roughly 25–30 WPM).

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit to apply?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 35 year for all positions, calculated as on the advertisement public date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly salary for the research positions?
faq.answer: The monthly emolument is Rs. 42,000 + HRA for Senior Research Fellow (SRF), Rs. 37,000 + HRA for Junior Research Fellow (JRF), and Rs. 24,000 + HRA for Junior Project Fellow (JPF).

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (Application Fees: Nil).

faq.question: Q7. How can candidates submit the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates can submit their duly filled form with required documents via email in PDF format to [email protected] or send it by hand, registered post, speed post, or courier to the DFO Narendra Nagar office.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: Selection will be made through initial screening of applications and an interview of shortlisted candidates conducted by the Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q9. Is this appointment permanent or contractual, and what is the tenure?
faq.answer: The engagement is purely contractual for an initial tenure of 11 months, extendable based on candidate performance and project approval.

faq.question: Q10. Can a candidate apply for more than one position?
faq.answer: Yes, but in case a candidate wishes to apply for more than one position, a separate application must be submitted for each post.
